title: ResearchClaim
description: A single researched claim with provenance, confidence, and type classification.

claimText.description: The claim itself, stated as a single sentence.

claimType.description: Epistemological type: fact (sourced), inference (derived), assumption (untested), recommendation (advised action).

source.description: URL or name of the source from which this claim is derived.

sourceDate.description: Date the source was published or last updated.

accessDate.description: Date this source was accessed for research.

supportingEvidence.description: Additional sources or claims that corroborate this claim.

contradictingEvidence.description: Sources or claims that contradict or qualify this claim.

reviewer.description: Agent or person who reviewed this claim for accuracy.
